discourse.excerpt: You must be like the sandalwood tree which transmits its fragrance even to the axe that is used to cut it.
discourse.theme: Peace is the fragrance of pure love — keep it intact under all circumstances and radiate happiness all around.
discourse.title: The quest for peace

reflection: Swami says peace is born of pure love and must be kept intact under all circumstances — like the sandalwood tree that gives fragrance even to the axe. Today, when criticism or ill-will comes your way, do not react in kind; stay calm, and answer with a kind word. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18, 9 Dec 1985)
seva_nudge: When someone is tense or upset today, be the calm in the room — listen fully before answering, and leave them a little more peaceful than you found them.

video.title: Peace Comes ONLY From Single-Pointed Attention On God | Sathya Sai Speaks | 14 July 1984
